title: TailnetCertVerifier duplicated across discovery.rs and peer_fetch.rs
description:
File: crates/kithd/src/discovery.rs lines 67-116, crates/kithd/src/peer_fetch.rs lines 213-272

The TailnetCertVerifier struct is defined identically in both files. Both implementations:
- Have identical struct fields and layout
- Have identical ServerCertVerifier impl with same method bodies
- Have identical safety rationale comments

Risk: Future changes to TLS verification (signature schemes, new methods, crypto provider selection) must be updated in both locations. A divergence between them would silently create different behavior for discovery probes vs. peer blob fetches.

Fix: Extract TailnetCertVerifier to a shared module (e.g., crates/kithd/src/tls.rs or similar) and import it in both discovery.rs and peer_fetch.rs.
